In this work, we deploy a facile and economical strategy to prepare atomically dispersed Ir atoms doped in spinel $\mathrm{C o}_{3}\mathrm{O}_{4}\left(\mathrm{I r}\cdot\mathrm{C o}_{3}\mathrm{O}_{4}\right)$ via a mechanochemical method. By introducing a trace amount of Ir (-1.05 at%),$\mathrm{Ir-Co_{3}O_{4}}$ displays a remarkable OER overpotential of 236 mV in an acid medium at the current density of 10 mA $\mathrm{cm}^{-2}$ ,which is significantly lower than that of as-prepared $\mathrm{C o}_{3}\mathrm{O}_{4}$ (412mV). Significantly, both the normalized mass activity and TOF of Ir $\cdot\mathsf{C o}_{3}\mathsf{O}_{4}$ can reach almost two order magnitudes higher than those of commercial $\mathbf{I r O}_{2}$ at an overpotential of 300 mV, respectively. Meanwhile, the stability can also be extended much longer after incorporating Ir single atoms within the lattice of $\mathrm{C o}_{3}\mathrm{O}_{4}$ . Using operando X-ray absorption near edge structure (XANES) at the $\mathrm{Ir}\cdot L_{3}$ and Co-K edges, it is observed that the Ir species are partially oxidized to OER-active $\mathbf{l r}^{>4+}$ ,and the elevated valence states with increased voltage also indicate that both high-valence Ir and Co atoms with their bridged electrophilic O ligands serve as atie swich arejoitly poilefrchatansfer in electrochmical action.In addition,dnsity functional thory (DFT)calculations confirm the improved electronic conductivity and facile energy barrier contributed by the incorporated Ir single atoms,resulting in a high OERcatalytic activity.Moreover,the preparation of $\mathrm{I r}-\mathrm{C o}_{3}\mathrm{O}_{4}$ can be easily scaled up to achieve gram-level per batch with negligible activity loss, demonstrating this strategy as an economical approach to prepare advanced electrocatalysts in a larger scale for practical applications.

In this work, we deploy a facile and economical strategy to prepare atomically dispersed Ir atoms doped in spinel $\mathrm{C o}_{3}\mathrm{O}_{4}\left(\mathrm{I r}\cdot\mathrm{C o}_{3}\mathrm{O}_{4}\right)$ via a mechanochemical method. By introducing a trace amount of Ir (-1.05 at%),$\mathrm{Ir-Co_{3}O_{4}}$ displays a remarkable OER overpotential of 236 mV in an acid medium at the current density of 10 mA $\mathrm{cm}^{-2}$ ,which is significantly lower than that of as-prepared $\mathrm{C o}_{3}\mathrm{O}_{4}$ (412mV). Significantly, both the normalized mass activity and TOF of Ir $\cdot\mathsf{C o}_{3}\mathsf{O}_{4}$ can reach almost two order magnitudes higher than those of commercial $\mathbf{I r O}_{2}$ at an overpotential of 300 mV, respectively. Meanwhile, the stability can also be extended much longer after incorporating Ir single atoms within the lattice of $\mathrm{C o}_{3}\mathrm{O}_{4}$ . Using operando X-ray absorption near edge structure (XANES) at the $\mathrm{Ir}\cdot L_{3}$ and Co-K edges, it is observed that the Ir species are partially oxidized to OER-active $\mathbf{l r}^{>4+}$ ,and the elevated valence states with increased voltage also indicate that both high-valence Ir and Co atoms with their bridged electrophilic O ligands serve as atie swich arejoitly poilefrchatansfer in electrochmical action.In addition,dnsity functional thory (DFT)calculations confirm the improved electronic conductivity and facile energy barrier contributed by the incorporated Ir single atoms,resulting in a high OERcatalytic activity.Moreover,the preparation of $\mathrm{I r}-\mathrm{C o}_{3}\mathrm{O}_{4}$ can be easily scaled up to achieve gram-level per batch with negligible activity loss, demonstrating this strategy as an economical approach to prepare advanced electrocatalysts in a larger scale for practical applications.

As expected,$\mathrm{Ir-Co_{3}O_{4}}$ exhibits the best OER performances among all studied samples. On the other hand, complex OER is always accompanied with other side reactions such as catalyst/support oxidation, material dissolution and capacitive current efects,which may lead to the overestimation of actual activity and thus it is essential to estimate the associated OER Faradaic efficiency (FE) of the $\mathbf{c a t a l y s t}^{57}$ Gas chromatography (GC) was used to continuously monitor the generated $\Omega_{2}$ amount and calculate the FE on $\mathrm{Ir-Co_{3}O_{4}}$ over a wide range of overpotentials (Supplementary Fig.27).As depicted in Fig. 3i,the corresponding $\mathbf{O}_{2}$ production increases with the increasing OER overpotentials; the calculated FE for OER remains at almost 100% at small overpotentials but drops slightly to 97% for large overpotentials.The relatively high FE values signify that the majority of energy is applied to drive OER and almost no side reactions occur on $\mathrm{Ir-Co_{3}O_{4}}$ Overall, the high electrode/intrinsic activity and electrochemical durability conjointly endow $\mathrm{Ir}-\mathrm{Co}_{3}\mathrm{O}_{4}$ as a promising OER electrocatalyst candidate for practical applications in the acidic water electrolyzer,namely proton exchange membrane water electrolyzer.
